_doc: Per-host agent selection for scripts/sync_prompt_pack.py. include: "all" or a list of agent source stems; exclude: stems, one per line. Excluded agents are the BENCH: synced to <host>/agents-bench/, which no host loads. `sync_prompt_pack.py bench play <stem>` makes one active, `bench sit <stem>` benches it (edits this file, re-syncs that host). A host not listed gets every agent. Bench today (operator 2026-10-25): finance agents while the centralize.biz tenant = data; anvil-qa, anvil-qa-ui (Anvil console only); regime-filter-tuner, strategy-honesty-checker (etrade/trading repo only). Never delete agent sources. See docs/contract-reference.md (Host agent selection).
